manifest.author: Kody Wildfeuer
manifest.description: Produces templated deal briefings, health scores, and competitive analyses for a named company, listing sales agents from the live RAR registry.
manifest.name: @kody-w/deal_desk_agent

command.description:
Command to run:
  analyze <company>   — full deal intelligence briefing for a company
  score <company>     — deal health score with risk factors
  compete <company>   — competitive landscape analysis
  stack               — show all available B2B sales agents in RAPP
  recommend <company> — suggest which RAPP agents to install for this deal
